name: wakaru
description: Wakaru (分かる) — a tiny WhatsApp bot that understands you. Built on Baileys + TypeScript.

scripts.build:sticker: cd native/sticker && cargo build --release && mkdir -p ../../bin && cp target/release/wakaru-sticker.exe ../../bin/sticker.exe || cp target/release/wakaru-sticker ../../bin/sticker
scripts.build:audio: cd native/audio && cargo build --release && mkdir -p ../../bin && cp target/release/wakaru-audio.exe ../../bin/audio2mp3.exe || cp target/release/wakaru-audio ../../bin/audio2mp3
